messages:
eva: quick heads-up — kb scan found a shortlink that's 404ing in staging :grimacing:

eva: link: https://kb.redwood.ai/s/gh/abcd123 (shows page not found)

sam: ack. which doc is this in?

eva: it's in /handbook/onboarding/getting-started.md, the inline shortlink was added in 2024-09 by @mira

mira: yep that's my edit — the upstream shortlink expired when we migrated the partner blog. thanks for flagging.

alex: I can take the PR for a quick swap to the canonical URL this afternoon if no objections.

mira: please do — patch should be tiny. prefer replacing with the canonical: https://blog.partner.com/onboarding-2023

sam: for CI quick fix we usually run:
```
# replace shortlink with canonical in repo
rg "s/gh/abcd123" -l | xargs sed -i '' 's|https://kb.redwood.ai/s/gh/abcd123|https://blog.partner.com/onboarding-2023|g'
```

alex: I'll open a branch and put up a PR, will target docs-maintenance label and assign @mira for review. pinging @eva for verification in staging once deployed.

docs-bot: kb-scan alert: shortlink-404 (id: 2991236543) — created ticket RED-1342

eva: thanks all. Alex — fyi CI snapshot checks tend to fail if images are remote; just update only the link.

alex: got it. opening PR now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2713

mira: lgtm if tests pass. can someone do the merge+deploy? I'm on calls after 5pm.

sam: I can merge and kick off the deploy after the tests. ETA ~1h.

eva: awesome :thumbsup: please drop the staging URL here once live so I can run the smoke curl.

sam: will do — follow-up in this thread. thanks everyone!
